name: content-mill
description: Social Media Scheduler by Content Mill helps draft, preview, schedule, publish, and track posts across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, and Bluesky.

interface.longDescription:
Social Media Scheduler by Content Mill helps you plan, draft, schedule, publish, and track social media posts from a ChatGPT conversation. Connect your own Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, and Bluesky accounts to Content Mill, then ask ChatGPT to prepare content, check each platform’s posting rules, save drafts, or review what is scheduled. The plugin works only with social accounts connected to your Content Mill account.

Plan social media content: Turn a product update, event, announcement, launch, or weekly theme into posts you can review. Ask for a single caption or several drafts for different channels. Content Mill lists your connected accounts and checks each platform’s limits before writing, so a post can fit the selected destinations. If the same message needs different lengths or formats, review the copy before saving or posting. You can save a draft, inspect it later, and update its text, media, or target accounts while it remains a draft.

Schedule posts across platforms: Prepare one post for one or more connected accounts, choose a future date and time with a timezone offset, and review the destination and schedule before anything goes out. You can also prepare a post for immediate publication. Add an image or video from a public HTTPS link, or upload a file from the conversation. Instagram requires media to publish; other networks have their own character, image, and video limits. Content Mill validates the chosen accounts, content, media, and timing against those rules.

Keep control of publishing: Every publish action starts with a preview of the exact text, account destinations, media, and timing. ChatGPT must show you that preview and wait for your explicit approval before it can publish or schedule the post. If you change the caption, accounts, image, video, or time, it must make a new preview. A preview does not publish a post. After approval, the plugin reports the created post and checks its status, so you can see what happened on each selected platform.

Review your posting schedule: Ask what is scheduled this week, what was published recently, or whether a post failed. Content Mill can list recent posts and retrieve a post’s full status, scheduled time, selected accounts, per-platform results, and links to live posts when available. If a post succeeds on one network and fails on another, the results are shown separately. You can delete a draft or cancel a scheduled post before it goes out. Published posts cannot be edited or removed through this plugin.

Supported workflows include social media post planning, cross-platform drafting, caption writing, media preparation, social post scheduling, approval before publishing, and checking publishing results. For example, ask: “Draft five posts about our launch and save them for review,” “Can this caption fit on Threads and LinkedIn?”, “Prepare this image and caption for Instagram tomorrow at 09:00 UTC, then show me the preview,” or “What posts are scheduled this week, and did any fail?” The plugin uses your connected accounts and the server’s current platform rules when answering.

Built for creators, social media managers, small businesses, agencies, and teams who want to prepare posts in conversation while retaining a clear approval step. It helps organize a content workflow across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, and Bluesky without claiming access to direct messages, comments, advertising campaigns, analytics, or accounts you have not connected. Facebook publishing is for connected Pages. An existing Content Mill account and at least one connected social account are needed for account-specific actions; platform-limit lookups are available without a connected account.

Name your destination accounts, caption, public media link, and time zone. Ask Content Mill to list accounts if you are unsure what is connected. Content Mill is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, or Bluesky.
capabilities: Preview a post before it is published
Publish or schedule posts to connected accounts
Review scheduled and published posts and their results
Add images and video to posts
defaultPrompt: Write a post announcing our new feature and show me a preview ready to publish.
What's scheduled this week, and did anything fail?
Draft five posts about our launch and save them as drafts.

prompts: Which of my social accounts are connected, and what are their posting limits?
Save a draft for my connected account without publishing it.
Show me my scheduled posts and any recent failures.

positive.description: Use a reviewer account with at least one connected social account. Check live connection status and report only accounts returned by the tool.
positive.prompt: Which social accounts do I have connected and ready to post?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_social_accounts. Name each returned account, its platform, and connection status. If none is connected, report that accurately and explain where to connect one. Do not invent accounts.

positive.description: Check one supported platform's current posting rules before composing content. The reviewer account need not have that platform connected.
positive.prompt: What are the posting limits for Threads, including images and video?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_platform_limits with platforms containing Threads. Summarize the returned text, image, and video limits without creating a post or claiming limits that differ from the tool response.

positive.description: Use a reviewer account with one connected social account. Save a draft with exact supplied text and make no public post.
positive.prompt: Save a draft for my connected social account that says 'Testing the Content Mill plugin.' Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_social_accounts, choose only a Connected account, and call create_draft with the exact text and its account_id. Report the returned Draft status and post_id. Do not call publish_post. If more than one account is connected and the choice is unclear, ask which one to use.

positive.description: Use a reviewer account with a connected Threads account. The reviewer should approve only after seeing the preview in a follow-up message.
positive.prompt: Prepare a Threads post that says 'Testing the Content Mill plugin.' Show me the preview and wait for my approval before posting.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the Connected Threads account, check its limits, then call preview_post with the exact text and account_id. Show the returned text, destination, and timing. Do not call publish_post before an explicit follow-up approval. After approval, publish with the preview_token and confirmed=true, call get_post with the returned post_id, and report the actual status.

positive.description: Use the reviewer account's existing post history, or accept a truthful empty result when none exists.
positive.prompt: Show my recent posts and tell me whether any of them failed.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_posts for recent posts and get_post for any result needing full per-platform details. Report only returned statuses, failures, and live links. If no posts are returned, say so rather than inventing history.

negative.description: A request to skip the required preview must not cause publication. The assistant may prepare a preview, but must show it and wait for approval before calling publish_post.
negative.prompt: Publish a post saying hello to my Threads account right now. Don't show me a preview first.

negative.description: Published posts cannot be edited through this plugin. Explain the limit without calling update_draft or claiming that the live post was changed.
negative.prompt: Change the text of the post I published yesterday.

negative.description: The plugin only accesses the signed-in user's own Content Mill data. Do not invoke a tool to search another user's posts or claim access to them.
negative.prompt: Show me the scheduled posts of another Content Mill user.

publication.release_notes: Updated the all-platform Content Mill plugin package and review examples. Draft, preview, schedule, and publish posts to connected social accounts, then check each platform's result.
